iid.title: IID holdout
iid.construction: Untouched final partition from the same simulator; independent of all fitting and selection.
iid.guarantee_scope: Exchangeability supports marginal coverage and label-conditional coverage for their respective methods; not a per-event certainty claim.

remote_work.title: Remote-work covariate shift
remote_work.construction: Fresh 40000-row pool; accept with probability (1+3*x0+2*x1+2*x2+2*x4)/10 and retain first 2000 accepted rows. Selection uses X only; labels are unchanged.
remote_work.guarantee_scope: Unweighted conformal has no general coverage guarantee after this covariate shift; no density-ratio correction is applied.

telemetry_masking.title: Missing telemetry stress
telemetry_masking.construction: Paired IID test; for a fixed random 50% of rows, replace columns 0,1,2,7,9 by zero. Retain original simulator labels.
telemetry_masking.guarantee_scope: Measurement corruption changes observed X/Y relationships; original conformal coverage need not transfer.

label_shift.title: Suspicious-prevalence shift
label_shift.construction: Fresh 40000-row pool; accept all suspicious rows and each legitimate row with probability .25; retain first 2000 accepted rows.
label_shift.guarantee_scope: Pure label-based sampling preserves X conditional on Y. Class-conditional coverage can transfer under this assumption; marginal coverage need not transfer.

methods.baseline: Validation-selected low threshold meeting at least 80% synthetic suspicious detection.
methods.marginal_gate: Baseline direct allow AND marginal prediction set exactly {legitimate}; otherwise step up.
methods.class_conditional_gate: Baseline direct allow AND class-conditional set exactly {legitimate}; otherwise step up.
methods.always_challenge: Every event requires challenge; trivial detection/friction upper-bound control.

labels.1: simulator suspicious; not confirmed attacks or human access votes

protocol.score_model: Same fixed LR/RF architecture, refit independently per seed; no interaction search.
protocol.probability_selection: Sigmoid fit on probability-calibration split; keep only positive slope and lower Brier on selection split, otherwise raw blend.
protocol.baseline_selection: Largest observed positive selection score attaining >=80% suspicious detection; no test or conformal labels used.
protocol.conformal_selection: Prespecified alpha=.1; 1-p(true class); exact ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)) order statistic, <= inclusion; q=1 if rank unavailable.
protocol.gate: Direct allow requires baseline allow AND prediction set exactly {legitimate}; empty/ambiguous/suspicious sets add step-up only.
protocol.challenge_definition: Any baseline challenge/block or added step-up; high-risk blocks are not separately estimated. No actual access is granted.
protocol.rejection_failure: Fail if fewer than 2000 accepted; do not adapt pool or retune conditions after observation.
protocol.aggregation: Five independent full fits; per-seed means, sample SD and range; no population CI from five seeds.
protocol.intervals: Per-run Wilson 95% intervals describe finite-test Bernoulli counts conditional on fitted models/calibration. They are not simultaneous or paired-difference tests and omit training/organization uncertainty.
protocol.hashes: SHA-256 over shape/dtype JSON header plus little-endian float64 X and int64 y; pool hashes and chosen-index hashes retained.

limitations: All features/outcomes come from one author-written probabilistic simulator. This is not deployment evidence, attack truth or a new conformal method.
Fresh seeds reduce dependence on a single draw but do not provide independent organizations, identity populations, fairness evidence or real attacker adaptation.
Marginal coverage can conceal poor suspicious-class coverage; report both classes. Coverage is averaged over calibration/test randomness, not a 90% certainty for each event.
IID exchangeability supports the corresponding coverage statement; unweighted coverage may fail after covariate shift or masked telemetry. No weighted conformal correction is implemented.
Pure label shift preserves X|Y by construction; that assumption can support class-conditional transfer but is not validated for real changes in attack prevalence.
Suspicious direct allow is bounded by suspicious set miscoverage for the conservative gate under applicable assumptions; it is not a bound on real access compromise.

Additional detection is purchased with additional legitimate challenges. Always-challenge trivially reaches 100% detection at 100% legitimate friction; no end-to-end challenge success, usability or cost was measured.
Telemetry masking uses zero as the existing feature default and retains latent labels; half of rows share the IID comparison and are paired, not independent populations.
Wilson intervals are descriptive finite-test intervals; rates across methods and paired conditions are dependent. No multiple-comparison significance claim is made.
This experiment writes a separate report only; it cannot approve reviewers, override policy, replace the runtime model or relax server-enforced grants.
